In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them.
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used.
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary.
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen.
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.

Represent each modeled internal workflow with bpmn:process. Use isExecutable=false unless execution-ready behavior is explicitly required and fully specified.
Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
Create reusable bpmn:message elements and messageRef only when communication content or shared message identity matters.

args.text: When the description states an activity or decision condition, use BPMN labels that faithfully preserve its stated meaning; do not replace it with a different action or add an unsupported action.

result.rule: When the description states an activity together with a purpose, object, or scope that distinguishes what is being done: Label the corresponding BPMN task with its core action and enough of those stated details to preserve the activity’s meaning; do not add unsupported details or omit details that distinguish it.

When the description gives an activity together with contextual or implementation details: label the corresponding BPMN element with its core action and object, omitting details that do not distinguish the activity.

When the description states that one participant sends an item or information to another participant: Label the corresponding BPMN activity from the sender’s perspective and preserve the sending action; do not replace it with the recipient’s receiving perspective.

When the description assigns an action to a particular participant or distinguishes that action from related actions: label each corresponding BPMN element with the described action and responsible participant; do not substitute another actor or conflate it with a separate action
